output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds an arbitrary amount to the target balance without ensuring it does not exceed the total supply, allowing the owner to obtain unintended funds.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows a user to transfer a large amount of tokens to an address, causing an overflow in the balanceOf mapping, which can be exploited to make the contract unusable.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows a user to transfer a large amount of tokens from an address, causing an overflow in the balanceOf mapping, which can be exploited to make the contract unusable.
